title: PAM Workflow Guide
text: pamflow R package automates pipeline passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) birds (vocalizing animal). point folder field recordings spreadsheet deployment dates, can: Standardize raw recorder dumps one clean folder structure (Stage 0) Read quality-check every audio file match deployment (Stage 1) Optionally filter low-frequency noise (Stage 2) Run custom BirdNET classifier detect species (Stage 3) Clean raw detections: remove false positives, merge overlapping calls (Stage 4) Let validate detector accuracy (precision, Stage 5) estimate recall annotated ground truth (Stage 5b) Build occupancy detection histories ready statistical modelling (Stage 6) Generate HTML, PDF Excel reports (Stage 8) second, independent workflow computes soundscape indices (ACI, ADI, AEve, Bio, H, M, NDSI) diel plots HTML report (Stages 2b 2c). Training BirdNET classifier separate, standalone tool (see appendix). Everything resumable (crashes, picks left ), reproducible (one config file controls settings), robust (one bad file never kills whole run).

title: PAM Workflow Guide
text: Q: Can resume crashed detection run? Yes. Rerun pam_detect(cfg). reads checkpoint skips completed files. pressed Esc computer crashed Python processes still running, call pam_birdnet_cleanup() first. Q: change confidence threshold? Edit processing.min_confidence config (give per-species thresholds CSV, see processing.species_thresholds_file) rerun Stage 4. need rerun Stage 3. Q: pamflow fit occupancy abundance models? . prepares input (Stage 7) checks ; fit models unmarked, ubms, spOccupancy another package. keeps pamflow free modelling dependencies lets choose model. Q: use per-species confidence thresholds? Run pam_species_thresholds(cfg, write = TRUE) validation, set processing.species_thresholds_file saved file rerun Stage 4, pass thresholds = pam_activity(), pam_richness() pam_count_history(). Q: see happened one recording? pam_audio_history(cfg, file = "G0059_20260405_183000.wav") lists stage recorded . Q: Can add species model later? Yes. Replace model files (train new classifier, see appendix), set new birdnet.run_id config, rerun Stage 3. Q: file names don’t match default pattern? Either let Stage 0 rename , change filenames.pattern config using named capture groups: (?<grid>...), (?<date>...), (?<time>...). Q: deployment sheet gives error odd dates. Check column order dd-mm-yyyy hh:mm formats (section 5.2), write grid number. outputs/deployment_issues.csv lists rows read. Q: much disk space need? Original audio, plus filtered copies (filtering), plus detection CSVs. 1 TB audio, budget 2.1 TB total. Q: Can use GPU? native Windows: TensorFlow longer supports , BirdNET runs CPU. Q: Can run Mac Linux? Yes. Install FFmpeg uv package manager (example brew install ffmpeg uv).
